note: The corpus strata the §4.1 release gate is about. Every document declares its own coordinates here rather than in prose, for the reason the acceptance fixtures give: a restriction stated only in a document's text lets an isolation check pass against an all-public corpus. Four strata are present on purpose -- a second tenant, group-restricted documents, a withdrawn document, and documents whose effective window excludes the query time. The §4.1 count for this fixture is therefore a finding rather than a shape: there are documents it could be nonzero about.
